acceptance.endpoint: C07-C08 ensemble recovers at least one of two low-support endpoints, with no loss of high-support or all relation endpoints.
acceptance.graph: Frozen C07-C08 graph node/edge precision>=0.98, node recall>=0.7043795620, edge recall>=4/13 and false loop<=0.01; fit node/edge precision>=0.98.
acceptance.interface: Step0 reproduces base structural logits/probability; causal context and conditional junction/terminal logits remain unchanged; 129 trainable parameters and zero base-model optimizer steps.
acceptance.population: Three seeds x200=600 residual optimizer steps; 564378 frozen-base inference observations; zero C09/C10/M-TARE.
acceptance.trigger_safety: At fixed 0.97, correctly classified decision episodes do not decrease and false triggers do not increase.

approval.confirmation_reference: User instructed automatic best-choice execution without routine approval prompts.
approval.scope: One immutable three-seed C01-C06 endpoint identity residual training and C07-C08 fixed-threshold/full-graph selection; no C09/C10/M-TARE.

estimated_cost.compute: Three frozen-base context extractions, 600 full-fit linear-head steps, one ensemble evaluation and one CPU graph replay.

failure_policy: Any hash/environment/count/determinism/leakage/resource/gate failure stops and seals FAIL. No retries with changed science.

methods.baseline: The exact zero residual reproduces the current action model and endpoint-geometry development graph.
methods.fallback: If fixed-threshold endpoint, global trigger or full graph gates fail, seal scientific FAIL and stop; do not tune threshold, losses or graph rules.
methods.main: Freeze all 237443 ActionSetNodeDetector parameters. Train a zero-initialized Linear(128,1) structural-logit residual (129 parameters) with original negative BCE + original all-episode MIL + endpoint identity mean of within-identity episode MIL, equal weight and no loss grid.

purpose: Recover rare relation-endpoint proposals without changing the frozen LiDAR representation, event class head, spatial centers, deployment threshold or graph contracts.
retention: Keep three residual checkpoints/histories/all-row outputs, ensemble comparison and figure, graph qualification tables/figures, logs, environment, RUN_STATE and seal. The existing shared token cache is read-only and not duplicated.

sampling.independent_units: Fit 72 relation endpoint identities/286 endpoint episodes; selection 26/110.

source.license_or_allowed_use: Local research use of project-generated procedural worlds and locally trained checkpoints.

split.fit: C01-C06 only supplies gradients and normalization already frozen upstream.
split.leakage_audit: Teacher identity is used only to group fit episodes in the auxiliary loss and to score selection; it is absent from model inputs and deployment.
split.selection: C07-C08 selects one checkpoint per seed among step0,10,...,200 and performs final ensemble/graph qualification.
split.strict_test: C10 remains unread until the revised development graph passes.
split.validation: C09 is not read and is no longer an independent validation source for this revised model.

teacher.labels: junction/terminal target, episode ID and relation-endpoint identity grouping.
teacher.source: Sealed corrected causal Teacher and sealed relation-endpoint inventory.
teacher.student_inputs: Only frozen five-frame exit tokens through the frozen ActionSetNodeDetector causal context.

title: GSE identity-balanced rare relation-endpoint structural residual

trajectories.rule: Reuse every sealed C01-C08 causal observation and completed traversal; no deletion or resampling.
